label: VERIFIED
extraction: GitHub repository with resources and examples for building multi-agent systems using modern frameworks: AG2 (AutoGen 2), CrewAI, LangChain/LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK. Framework comparison table: AG2 frames everything as async conversation between specialized agents with multi-agent collaboration, tool integration, code execution, event-driven architecture for concurrent work. CrewAI: role-based orchestration with agents assigned roles (Researcher, Writer, Critic). LangGraph: represents agent reasoning as DAG for deterministic flows. OpenAI Agents SDK: lightweight runtime with function-calling and agent handoffs, guardrails for safety. Google ADK: agent development kit. Key concepts: memory/context management (persistent state), workflow orchestration (flows, DAGs, event-driven architectures managing order, error handling, retries).
